title: heptapleurum rigidum var. venosum

The Bitter Moon plant has been traditionally used in various cultures for its medicinal properties, and it is valued for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of the Bitter Moon plant are primarily composed of flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
